summary: Passage Bio filed an 8-K on September 2, 2026, disclosing an amended and restated merger agreement with Remix Therapeutics. The deal, originally announced June 24, 2026, restructures the acquisition into a two-step merger: Merger Sub merges into Remix, then the surviving entity merges into Merger Sub II, both wholly owned subsidiaries of Passage Bio. The transaction is intended to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under Section 368(a). Concurrent financing via pre-funded warrants to purchase Remix common stock will convert into warrants for Passage Bio shares. No financial terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for shareholder approvals and closing conditions.
